name: Doro Wot Deluxe
shortDescription: Traditional slow-cooked chicken stew infused with aromatic berbere and spiced butter, served with boiled egg and injera.
description: Addis Ababa's crown jewel. A rich, slow-cooked tender chicken drumstick gently simmered for hours in our house-blended berbere, caramelized red onions, crushed garlic, ginger, and spiced niter kibbeh butter. Served with a hard-boiled organic farm egg and two rolls of freshly baked 100% teff injera.

name: Awaze Beef Tibs
shortDescription: Tender cubes of beef sautéed in spicy awaze paste, rosemary, caramelized onions, and jalapeños.
description: Cubed tenderloin flash-seared with fresh awaze paste, rosemary sprigs, garlic, and fresh green chili, finished in clarified spiced butter for a smoky, peppery bite.

name: Addis Special Kitfo
shortDescription: Finely minced lean beef seasoned with spiced niter kibbeh butter, mitmita, served with ayib.
description: Premium lean minced beef seasoned with fragrant niter kibbeh, fiery mitmita, paired with fresh ayib (Ethiopian cheese) and a bed of gomen.

name: Gourmet Beyaynetu
shortDescription: Vibrant combination of spicy misir wot, kik alicha, collard greens, shiro, and fresh salad.
description: A generous fasting platter combining spicy misir wot (red lentils), kik alicha (mild split peas), sautéed collard greens, creamy shiro, and a fresh side salad, all served on injera.

name: Shiro Tegabino Pot
shortDescription: Rich powdered chickpea stew bubbling hot in a traditional clay pot with garlic and diced tomatoes.
description: A bubbling clay pot of powdered chickpea stew, simmered with garlic, ginger, diced tomatoes, and berbere, served straight from the fire for maximum warmth.

name: Addis Clay Oven Pizza
shortDescription: Crispy thin crust topped with spiced minced beef, mozzarella, caramelized onions, and mild green chili.
description: Fired in a traditional clay oven, this thin crust pizza is topped with spiced minced beef, mozzarella, caramelized onions, and a scattering of mild green chili for a local twist.

name: Gusto Smoky Beef Burger
shortDescription: Handmade beef patty with aged cheddar, caramelized onions, crisp lettuce, and Addis house secret sauce.
description: A juicy handmade beef patty topped with aged cheddar, slow-caramelized onions, crisp lettuce, and our smoky house secret sauce, stacked in a toasted brioche bun.

name: Classic Addis Macchiato
shortDescription: Rich double shot of Ethiopian Yirgacheffe espresso layered with velvety textured steamed milk.
description: Addis-style layered dark roast espresso with dense micro-foamed milk, prepared from high-altitude Yirgacheffe beans grown in the Ethiopian highlands.

name: Fresh Mango & Avocado Spris
shortDescription: Signature layered Addis fresh fruit juice with ripe mango, creamy avocado, and a fresh lime twist.
description: Thick, layered cold-pressed Hass avocado and sweet Arba Minch mango puree, topped with freshly squeezed lime for a bright finish.

name: Sizzling Shekla Tibs
shortDescription: Prime beef sautéed with rosemary, red onions, garlic and fresh green jalapeño peppers, served sizzling.
description: Prime cubed beef seared with rosemary, red onion, garlic, and fresh jalapeño, brought to your table sizzling in a traditional shekla clay dish.

name: Veggie Supreme Pizza
shortDescription: Wood-fired thin crust loaded with peppers, mushrooms, olives, and fresh mozzarella.
description: Our wood-fired thin crust loaded with bell peppers, mushrooms, kalamata olives, red onion, and fresh mozzarella.

name: Spiced Chicken Burger
shortDescription: Crispy berbere-spiced chicken fillet with slaw and spicy mayo in a toasted bun.
description: A crispy berbere-dusted fried chicken fillet, crunchy cabbage slaw, and spicy mayo, stacked in a toasted sesame bun.

name: Tej — Honey Wine
shortDescription: Traditional Ethiopian honey wine fermented with gesho leaves, served chilled in a berele.
description: Traditional fermented honey wine, brewed with gesho leaves for a lightly bitter, floral finish, served chilled in a classic berele flask.
